How do polygraphs work?

Short answer is, they don't.

The longer answer is that they actually do measure certain physiological things: pulse, respiration, muscle movements and galvanic skin response about which many assumptions are made in general as to what effect lying has on those measurements, and then the polygraph examiner does a lot of subjective interpretation of the measurements to determine whether or not in their opinion you were truthful.

The machine does not detect lies. That part is 100% bullshit. And they are trivially easy to beat for people who don't believe in the bullshit.

Nothing detects lies, but the science behind it when someone lies is there, which is what is used.

I think it's a good technique, but shouldn't be depended on solely for a conviction. I mean, most cases are decided by a Judge or Jury and "their opinion" on whether or not the person should be convicted.

The science is that we are actually able to measure pulse, respiration, muscle contraction and perspiration.

The bullshit is the assumptions that they make about whether these things tell us someone is lying. Lots of things cause the same physiological characteristics that a polygraph examiner will think indicates lying. Things like nervousness because this one guy's opinion, based on pseudoscience, can end your career. Things like having eaten too much greasy food and desperately trying to hold back the imminent diarrhea until your interrogation is over. Things like having had too much caffeine because you couldn't sleep all night before you get grilled by someone who can just decide, based largely on his own assumptive beliefs in a practice we know is not scientifically sound that your career should be over and you should be the target of a criminal investigation for treason.

They also assume a lot based on the so-called control questions, some of which they expect you to lie about, and they also assume that the physiological response to those lies will be lesser because they're more general. They then use that as a baseline lie for assumptions about other responses. It's all a mountain of bullshit built on a foundation of nothing.
